notes: `popovertarget` turns a plain button into a toggle for the `popover`: it gets `aria-expanded`, the menu opens in the top layer (never clipped by overflow), Tab moves straight from the button into the menu, and Escape or a click outside closes it and restores focus. The invisible overlay label from 2014 is gone.

Anchor positioning ties the menu to its button with `position-area`, and `position-try-fallbacks` flips it above or to the other side when there is no room below. Where anchor positioning is missing, the `popover` shows centered on screen and still works.

The hover variant uses `interestfor`, which opens the menu on hover, keyboard focus or long-press, with delays set in CSS through interest-delay. It also keeps `popovertarget` with `popovertargetaction="show"`, so a click opens it in browsers without interest invokers.
